item.title: Penn State to Play at Northwestern on Friday Night in October for Debut of New Ryan Field
item.description: Penn State football's trip to Northwestern will be a historic one. The Nittany Lions' Week 5 matchup against the Wildcats will be played on Friday, Oct. 2, at the new Ryan Field, Penn State confirmed on Tuesday. It will be the first game played at the stadium, which was built over the site of the old Ryan Field, which had hosted Northwestern home games from 1926-2023. item.title: Fire Damages Philipsburg Area Business
item.description: A Philipsburg area business sustained heavy damage in a fire on Tuesday morning. The Philipsburg Fire Department dispatched at about 8:50 a.m. to Bombshell Salon at 999 Tyrone Pike in Rush Township after multiple calls reported smoke coming from the building, according to Hope Fire Company. Crews arrived on scene to find a working fire in the single story salon and called for a second alarm to dispatch assistance from Mountain Top Fire Company. item.description: State College Area School District's planning for a new Park Forest Middle School moved forward on Monday night with board approval of final designs for a project that is now estimated to cost up to $152 million. item.title: $1M in Federal Funding to Support Radio Upgrades for Emergency Personnel Across Centre County
item.description: Centre County will receive $1 million in federal funding to support the replacement and upgrade of emergency radio equipment for first responders throughout the county, the Board of Commissioners announced on Tuesday. The money will "kickstart" the project to provide approximately 1,400 new mobile and portable radios to fire, EMS and police agencies, Centre County Deputy Administrator Natalie Corman said.
